in_sanskrit.name: Eila
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of abundance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Eila एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Eila is the goddess of abundance and prosperity. She is often depicted holding a bowl overflowing with grains or gold. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'eela' meaning 'a flow' or 'a current'. Eila is a symbol of the continuous cycle of life and the abundance of nature.
